cd /workspace/mytests && python3 - <<'EOF'
import random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/mytests')
from diff_parse import compare, rand_channel, rand_request
from modules import byte_program as bp
from modules.capture_audit import parse_requests, Budget
import ref_parser as ref

# byte soup biased towards framing characters
alpha = b'\r\n0123456789abcdefABCDEF ;:/HTP.1GOST-x\r \t' + bytes(range(32,60))
bad = 0
for seed in range(4000):
    rnd = random.Random(seed+100000)
    n = rnd.randrange(0, 60)
    data = bytes(rnd.choice(alpha) for _ in range(n))
    try:
        compare(data, 'soup%d'%seed)
    except AssertionError as e:
        bad += 1
        if bad < 3: print('MISMATCH', e)
print('soup done, bad =', bad)

# boundary lengths: lines just under/over 8192/8193/8194
for L in (8190, 8191, 8192, 8193, 8194, 8195):
    for term in (b'\r\n', b'\n'):
        data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1' + term + b'A'*L + term + b'\r\n'
        compare(data, 'len%d'%L)
        data2 = b'A'*L + term
        compare(data2, 'len2%d'%L)
        data3 = b'A'*L  # no terminator
        compare(data3, 'len3%d'%L)
print('line boundaries OK')

# block size boundary
for nf in (126,127,128,129,130):
    data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b''.join(b'X%d: v\r\n'%i for i in range(nf)) + b'\r\n'
    compare(data, 'nf%d'%nf)
for size in (65530, 65534, 65535, 65536, 65537, 65540):
    pad = size - 16
    data = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n' + b'X:' + b'a'*(pad-4) + b'\r\n' + b'\r\n'
    compare(data, 'blk%d'%size)
print('block boundaries OK')
EOF
